title: Machine learning predicts persistent fever after antibiotics in two cancer cohorts
summary: Using routine clinical records, the study predicted persistent fever after antibiotic treatment in two cancer cohorts. The best point-estimate model achieved AUROC 0.82 in the internal cohort and 0.78 at an external hospital. This retrospective prediction study does not establish effects on antibiotic use or patient outcomes.
